evidence_items.title: BenchUp3D/benchup
evidence_items.summary: Free, open-source 3D woodworking and modeling software and SketchUp alternative. Built with Rust, WebAssembly and WebGPU. Runs in your browser or on desktop. 100% vibe-coded with great emphase on stability, rendering speed and UI/UX. evidence_items.title: HexaFuture/EmbodiedLab
evidence_items.summary: Manipulation benchmarks test acting to change; EmbodiedLab tests acting to know. Given only an objective and the apparatus, a robot runs its own experiment in a physics-based lab to find out a result it cannot know in advance. 30 science experiments, scored exactly. Topics: ai-for-science, benchmark, embodied-ai, isaac-sim, llm-agents, physics-simulation, robot-manipulation, robotics, scientific-discovery
